content:
Kai (support): escalating Nimbus Health (trial) at 14:03 UTC. Image ingestion + embeddings failing for new users — demo blocked, asking for CS comms and fast workaround.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-8133 — embed pipeline errors region=us-west3. Pager notified.
Olivia (csm): joining. Can we get a short cause so I can update the customer and offer alternatives?
Dev (support-eng): quick log snippet:
```
[14:04:12] svc=ingest id=img-77 err=chunk_truncate bytes=312000
[14:04:17] embed_id=img-77 score=null err=postprocess_failed
```
Looks like proxy chunking + postprocess worker OOM for larger images.
Marco (sre): confirmed worker OOMs on pool nimbus-embeds; increasing worker replicas and routing to a warm pool. ETA ~9m.
Olivia (csm): draft comms: "Hi Nimbus team  we saw intermittent failures ingesting larger images this afternoon. Engineers are routing you to a warm pool and increasing workers; expect stability within ~15 minutes. As an interim option we can accept smaller images (<250KB) or upload via API key for admins. We'll follow up with a timeline and a one-time trial extension.  Olivia, CSM"
Dev (support-eng): recommend enabling admin API upload bypass for 2 users now (audit logged)  reduces proxy chunk path.
Kai (support): DMed Nimbus: "We've routed traffic and can enable an admin bypass if helpful. Latency/error rate improving  would you like a 15m status call?"
Nimbus (external): "Please enable bypass for Alice + Raj, taking the call at 3pm PT. Thanks for fast help."
ops-bot: ALERT UPDATED: INC-8133 mitigation in progress action=route warm_pool time=14:12
Marco (sre): post-route metrics p50=410ms p95=1.3s error_rate=0.6% (was 6%). I'll attach OOM traces to the incident and propose warm-worker preloads.
Olivia (csm): assigning owner: Olivia. I'll update account health, mark renewal-watch until postmortem, and prepare follow-up email + credit offer. Closing thread  continuing in calendar invite.
